# SD13-E3 deterministic Human Rogue level 1 chassis baseline fixture.
# Represents a deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Rogue level 1 chassis as
# chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed,
# or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam
# (ability-bonus and bonus-feat) and stays a single-class, level-1-only chassis
# baseline.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Rogue burden surface: no base-attack or
# base-save progression (3/4 BAB / poor Fortitude / good Reflex / poor Will),
# no sneak attack damage-die execution, no trapfinding Perception/Disable
# Device bonus, no rogue talent, no level-2+ progression. It adds only the
# minimum feat and selected-skill posture needed to make the bounded level-1
# chassis legible; the rogue base-attack, base-save, sneak-attack, and
# trapfinding burdens are intentionally left for the runtime and matrix to
# name as still blocking.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-rogue-level1
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:rogue:1
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:17
ability=constitution:12
ability=intelligence:12
ability=wisdom:10
ability=charisma:10
feat=feat:weapon_finesse
skill=skill:stealth:1
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:dexterity
